reviews.text: Bugs from the beginning. I have downloaded the app and went via first 28 screens. I marked that I am a male, yet choose your body type shows woman and all other screens do too. Finally close to the end it tells me that woman over 40 should aim to this and this … I have not even started but it is already hell a confused onboarding.

Not worth it. Transition time and poses than make sense for transitions are non-existent. 
Voice instructions often do not match the pose shown on the screen.
Many advanced moves are included in beginner plans.
Losing money. This app is billing me and I can’t find a way to cancel the subscription. I’m not calling it a rip-off but I feel that way.

Not as I thought. I downloaded this app and paid for it only to find out that it isn’t what I thought it would be. The advertisement led to me to believe I could do certain exercises that would work on certain areas and that’s not what it does. I find it hard to follow and I wish I could get my money back. I tried to contact them through the support link and it took me to an error page. I want a refund.

Updates. First of all I really like the app and it has been instrumental in my weight loss and fitness plan. However, I get a little frustrated right after the app updates. It seems that the timing is off or the instructions aren’t the same. Some poses are done on one side of the body only when it was on two. Instructions say incorrect direction to face. Not huge things, but it would be great to have them fixed. Going from a few seconds of low cobra to a minute was not nice. 😰

Very easy to use and great deal for the money!. I’ve been doing yoga for a long time, but find it difficult to keep up a consistent practice and definitely don’t have time to attend face-to-face classes. 

I think this app is perfect particularly for those with a little experience in yoga. I think you need a little practice with transitions, because those are not shown clearly. 

That said I can do the poses easily and quickly and after a time or two, you can follow completely with audio. It’s getting me motivated and helping me strengthen muscles and increase flexibility, as well as limbering up joints. I’m a very active 51 year old and using this in Lou or addition to physical therapy has been a great benefit.
Can’t Cancel. Trying to cancel subscription. Followed directions using Apple Support and there is NO cancel option for Nandy Yoga.
App misrepresented. I download the app based on an ad I saw. Paid the yearly price to get the workouts and what is saw on the ad doesn’t exist. Very disappointed
The app keeps crashing. It’s a great app but today it keeps crashing when I hit practice
Can’t cancel. I have read articles on how to cancel this but it will. Or allow me to do so. This is ridiculous. It seems easy for them to take my money but impossible to stop it

Need to fix bugs. I love this yoga app, however yesterday when I opened it up on my iPad it let me view only half the page with the bottom half covered by a blue box. I couldn’t click on the arrow to start the practice. I tried going to the app to see if there were any updates (none), I rebooted my tablet. Nothing worked. So.. I downloaded Nandy yoga on my iPhone. One huge problem. The Nandy yoga icon did not appear on my home page so to access the app I have to go to the App Store and tap “OPEN “. If this app was free I would make do. But I’ve paid for a full year TWICE and am struggling with accessing content. Now, all I can do is view poses and make up my own timing.

Issue with usage. In the last 2 days this app has become unusable. I cannot access the screen as all content is zoomed out. My device did update. Is my Nandy yoga version no longer compatible? I love the app and the options and am so sad it is not working
Ipad compatibility. For 3 years I have used this app on my iPad. Now I cannot. I want my money back

Possible incompatibility with this app on iPad with new iOS 16.1.1. I just spent a couple of hours with Apple tech support trying to figure out what is wrong with this app. I have had the app for almost three years without any problems. Yesterday, I installed the newest iOS 16.1.1 on my iPad. The tech and I went through several troubleshooting maneuvers: deleting the app, reinstalling the app, shutting down the iPad, etc. It worked once. I tried the app a second time and it didn’t work again. I went through the same maneuvers, however, this time it does not work. The Apple Technician thinks there is a compatibility problem with the app and the new operating system on an iPad. I have an iPhone and do not have any problems using the app. I really like this app and I hope the developers can quickly fix whatever problems exist.

Use it daily. Nice app! I always feel like I’ve had a good stretch and the practices allow for longer or shorter workouts so I can make it work for my busy schedule. I have been disappointed in how many sessions have incorrect directions that don’t match the illustrated poses. Many errors in the right/left parts of the body. I can figure it out, but feel that these should be corrected in the updates. I have had this app for over a year and the audio hasn’t been corrected. 🙃

Love it but have a problem. I love the app and when I’m healthy I use it every day. Right now though I can’t see the full screen. I’ve sent requests for help and no one answers. I don’t know what to do. I pay for something I can’t use,

Not for beginners or older people. I put my age and my concerns in… I guess beginner to these people means something completely different than what I mean. Apparently I’m below beginner. If you have any knee issues, don’t bother with this. Also, you’d better be able and to plank easily and do a push up. Lovely app, easy to use, beautiful layout etc, but not for beginners or older people unless you’re already very fit
No cancel button on the App to cancel. Very upset that this App is making it hard to cancel..Why don’t you have a button o cancel ?

Representation. The ability to change skin tone, hair color, and body shape of the pose guide would be an excellent alteration to this app. While I do enjoy the poses, timer, audio tones, ability to create a custom flow, representation for other races and body styles is a must in todays social climate.
Frustrated. I cannot delete this app

Nandy Yoga. I do not wish to renew this app. It will not let me unsubscribe. Please let me know what I need to do so I will not get charged. 
Thank you.

Starting again from the beginning. Had to uninstall and reinstall to get it to work again. Signed in, but all the programs have changed and my past accomplishments are gone. Oh well, starting over again with the first program.

Started good- then pffff…. At first L loved Nandy yoga- good beginner workouts that moved in progression. But after I completed one session ( and bought the year long program) there were LOTS of problems. I started Slim and Fit 1 and the program would not advance to the next session, it only offered me the first session over and over. I tried a second group, and it was the same issue. I am probably goi g to cancel.

Over charged. It stated 19.99 for the month, so I signed up
For one month and was charged 22.98!

Bug fixes. It used to be a 5-Star. It’s a good app but the most recent update is hard to figure out. If you accidentally hit “plan” at the bottom, you can’t pause. More so, if you get a phone call and “plan” (along with the rest of the menu) is up, it will freeze your practice and you can’t resume. 

I also don’t like that I can’t replay a particular lesson anymore. It just chooses the lesson for you. So far, I have redone the same lesson 4x.

So, I hope they fix it quickly b/c the previous version was better. It was simpler, but these new features don’t work well.
No dynamic step by step pose. It just shows static pictures of the Yoga pose.It should be dynamic poses with voice explanation.

Used to love - but now horrid. I started using the app in March and although it had a few bugs here and there I stuck with it for over 175 days straight. Then the “updates” started. The bugs increased, whole sections of personalized programs disappeared and others were shortened to uselessness. You were left standing or in simple poses for a minute and then rushed through complicated ones. I provided lots of detailed feedback to the developer and each update worsened the program. None of the programs I was using like Fit & Slim and Master of Slim remain now. I can’t even find them in the app at all. Literally just gone in the middle of Antistress and several others. I was doing really well with my goals but now I’m so frustrated with this app I haven’t been consistent in a few weeks. Unfortunately as the feedback has never been addressed I will have to seek another yoga app for my goals. SO VERY DISAPPOINTED
Time to cancel. I like the app but have multiple myeloma and can no longer participate. How do I cancel my membership?

Bad in my opinion. When I first got this app i thought it was going to be free but when i actually dowloaded it and started putting some information to actually lose weight everything was locked and it said i had to pay so i think that they should make it free because i dont have money so yeah make the workouts free
Changed the app. I was pretty happy with the app to start with, then everything changed. I will not renew when my year is up.

Started out good. I loved this app to begin with. Priming myself to stick with something took me a little bit, I would start and do a day or two then it would take a week to do another one. Then I broke my foot so I took a month off. Every time I came back the programs looked a little different. I chalked it up to my sporadic sessions and it was personalized. Well now I have been doing the “fit and slim I” 25 day beginner course. I was prepared for, excited about day 20. I’m on a roll!! Open the app and everything is changed, the beginner is now 12 days, all the programs have changed!! Massive unannounced changes while in the middle of “personalized” programs is not very personal! It’s mass production that does not even begin to feel personal! I certainly did not expect one on one attention, I did expect a series of programs based on my general need. If people were asking for a smaller time chunks then you should have added them without taking away from current customers. Right now I am not happy with app!

I WAS really satisfied😞. I really like this app and bragged about the value to others. I recommended to a lot of people and have been enjoying my workouts immensely. Then, I opened the app to workout this morning and large majority of the programs are less than half the length they used to be. When I purchased the app many of the programs were 25-30 days of workouts and now they are 9-12 days! What happened??? Why would you reduce the number of workouts? This app does seem like it contains the value that I paid for anymore. I am extremely disappointed! I also feel cheated, because I paid for one thing and after my purchase part of what I purchased was taken away from me. I think you can do better than this!
How do I cancel membership?. Ok
Arthritis in knee. There are several positions I cannot do at all because my knee will not allow it. Suggest alternative
Junk, and expensive for what they offer.. Really a waste of time & money
Great app!. This is a great app! It is so easy to use and the exercise is handled with consideration of those who are just beginning to do yoga! I really love it!

Not worth it. I had high hopes but this app isn’t worth the money. I picked a beginner plan because I haven’t practiced yoga in a while. I was surprised when the first sequence it recommended included bow pose, which can be very difficult to get into and is definitely not for beginners (especially if you’re practicing alone without feedback).

There is no flow between asanas and almost no instructions for breathing. Yoga is not just getting in and out of different poses like you’re rotating between crunches and jumping jacks. 2 stars because the app itself is visually appealing. But definitely not worth $20 a month in any way.

Nandy. Nice app, really great to be motivated again! Thank you! 
🙏

Love this app!. I am a 60 year old. I’m in good shape as I walk a lot. I used to run but over the years my knees have weakened and I continuously injured myself. 
This app is very easy to follow. The details really help me get the pose correct. I find it challenging. I love feeling a million small supporting muscles working. 
After just two months I feel tighter and stronger. I have started to jog walk easily. I know this will be increasingly valuable as i age. 

I Love this program! Well done!!
Thanks, Nancy
Hi. I opened this app twice don’t ask me to write a review

Charged me and I didn’t want the app. I tried to get a hold of the Yep once I realized that it was going to charge me. However, it looks like it automatically charged me which is frustrating. I do not want this app and want my account credited.

Believe your peers and skip this app. Everyone wants to make money, that’s not a problem. What IS a problem: pretending this is free when it really isn’t. Also, the reviews stated how they are unable to cancel, only to be met with automated responses to contact support. (This occurred even with the reviewer who actually contacted support resultlessly.) There are apps out that are either actually free or that state was what is or is not a paid feature. This money hungry grab for download counts is deceitful. (Developer, please do not respond. I will not send an email to your support team and you have proven by your previous responses that you are not truly interested in what consumers are telling you.)

Lost All Data. Opened the app to do my yoga session only to find my program and all data gone. Coincidentally, this happened the day after my credit card was charged. I canceled my subscription immediately.
Débutant. J’en suis à mes débuts et espère m’appliquer et avoir les résultats escomptés. Je reviendrai régulièrement avec mes avis au fil des entraînements.

I like it. Is it perfect? No. But I’ve been doing it consistently for about 2 weeks and my pants are fitting better. I’ve never been consistent with an exercise app before. I like that you can see how many minutes you spent in it for a week. It’s worth it to me.
Always a subscription 😡. I was so pumped to use this app… But there’s always a subscription! I’m not paying $20 a month… Let alone $150 (for “forever” rights) to use this app… It’s not gonna happen

HORRIBLE!. Worst ever! I can’t believe I wasted my money on this! It’s just an animated figure showing different poses. A voice describes what to do and doesn’t even call the poses by their names! There are no transitions between poses it just jumps from one pic to the next. I can’t even figure out how to get in touch with anybody to cancel my subscription! What a nightmare!

Won’t let me cancel. Hello. I tried the app but didn’t like the lack of transitions and computer voice. So I am trying to cancel but I can’t find account information anywhere in dashboard or elsewhere. HELP! This feels scammy.
Don’t download. Unless you’re ready to be locked into a subscription that you can’t cancel, don’t download. I have never had this much difficulty canceling anything in my life. Seriously.

No Nonsense and Effective. If you’re anything like me, you can’t stand over talkative yoga instructors in videos who go on and on instead of getting to the pose. I love that this app gets right to it! I don’t mind the robotic voice, so long as it’s giving me clear instructions and visuals. What’s also great is that workouts are short but effective. Excellent yoga app, especially for beginners like me.

IT IS NOT FREE. The way that this is presented in the App Store it leads to the person who is downloading it to believe that they can access the exercises for free. You can download this app for free but as soon as you start to access the exercises it wants you to subscribe. Perhaps a little more honesty and advertising would be necessary here.
Paid App for programs. Just mention its a paid app and don't waste peoples time.

really enjoying the app. Hello - do I need to delete the app for the update to work? I’m concerned I may lose my account. I paid for a whole year. I did update but I think I’m stuck on certain day 9. Also at the end of the session, it repeats the last pose so I have to advance to the end. I’ve enjoyed the app so far.sent an e-mail to the App support but unsuccessful.😔

Cool workouts. First off, I really like how the app is designed, well done you guys. At first I was a bit hesitant to pay for it, as it seemed a little pricey to me, but decided to go for a monthly subscription. I have used this app for not more than few days, but overall I liked it. The workouts are easy to do, I don’t feel like I hold the pose for way too long. Each pose has a descriptive illustration and audio instruction. I really like the «Slim waist» and the «7 min workout» program. Also, the «breathing» section of the app is nice, but I would suggest to add more music options in future updates.

App won’t unlock !. I downloaded this app and have tried several times to open it - all exercises/programs are locked and I don’t see how to unlock them. I wonder did I pay for this ? And yet can’t access the app?

Horrible app. Claims to be personalized recommendations but you still pick from a bunch of options. At the end of a session it doesn’t give you credit for it. The transitions between moves are horrible and it doesn’t keep the left right sides consistent through out. Even the ability to email support is poorly done so there is no way to contact anyone. Wish I had not purchased as it’s a waste of money.
You must pay to use. You must pay to use the basic features of this app
One day & now trying to get to second. Onlyonly
Time out is TERRIBLE!. Latest update is causing my iPhone to time out. Kind of hard to touch the screen to keep it active while in a pose. If this doesn’t get fixed, how do I get a refund?

Programs disappeared from app. I have been using this app over 3 months, and when I opened it today, all my multi-day programs are gone. I am very unhappy as I was using this app most days! Help!
Solution appeared as soon as the programs showed up the next day by magic, and a nice note came from the developer saying they had been working on the problem! Thanks for helping me so quickly!

Not loving the update. I’ve enjoyed using this app over the last month, but with the last update we lost the clock at the bottom which means my phone goes to sleep in the middle of poses which is frustrating and the opposite of the mindset you want to be in while doing yoga.

Did last update remove timer?. I am really enjoying the app so far and have been using it for about a week. This morning the program didn’t have the timer or next pose section available. Is it a glitch or has it been removed permanently?

Also, I don’t have access to the statistics section shown in the App Store, does my subscription not include that?

Thank you for looking into this!

Please fix. There are quite a few instances where the audio is not correctly matched with the video. Also, most recent update will not keep my iPad awake during the session and I have to keep leaving a pose to tap my screen awake.
Project to TV screen enhancement available?. I love this app but It would be great to project to a smart TV screen. Is that possible?
What happened to count down timer?. Upgraded and pose figurine is smaller and countdown clock is gone

It’s awful. Don’t waste your money. This app is simply put... awful. It turns off mid excersize or stretch aboit every 30 to 45 seconds. I purchased the app today & tried 4 different programs on 2 different devices amd had the same problem on all 4. It is impossible to get a good stretch or a peaceful stretch when you are constantly having to reach for your device to turn the app back on.
Also, there is no flow at all from one stretch or excersise to the next, which also makes having a relaxing or useful workout impossible. 
I will be demanding my money back 1st thing Monday morning.
Do NOT pay for this app
You will be very unhappy
Some changes. I like it so far.. although it doesn’t give you enough time to come out of a position before it goes into another.
Can’t get program to work. Freezes on phone

Buttons and links don’t work. I purchased this app and tried to use it on the first day and the buttons were not working. I tried to send an email to the support services the send email button did not work.

Ridiculous. I get that you’re trying to make money but this app doesn’t even offer a sample or at least some type of free feature. It just gears you right to the purchase, why would I do that for something that’s the same as other workout apps.

No pressure Just ease of tension!. I love this app. I don't feel any pressure to answer a ton of personal questions, and I am not bothered with notifications! This way I look forward to choosing the time and routine that works for me. I am easing into it as a beginner, and I feel so good afterwards, instead of sore and exhausted.

No cancel option??!. I downloaded app to look it over and subscribed in error. I instantly started looking for how to cancel subscription, and there is nothing. I sent in feedback form and have gotten no response. Days have passed, I’ve never heard from anyone. I am no accepting that I will never get my money back for initial subscription fee, even though I have never used the app. My concern is next month. There HAS to be a way to UNSUBSCRIBE!!!
Wonderful. Great for beginners. The poses are very easy to follow. The directions are clear and simple. The beginner is very convenient and doing 8 minutes is not intimidating!
Doesn’t work. App just goes in circles never opening. I reached out to developers and no response.
Yoga. I have picked this yoga app for strength, weight loss and flexibility and find very user friendly so far...

Overcharged. I was overcharged and I’ve contacted support but there has been no reply. If your response to these negative reviews is going to be to contact support then you need to actually have a customer support system!

Regret I made this purchase. I dislike the graphics and the instructions are very robotic and I found the verbal instructions were frequently not accurate. There was no modifications included and the beginner quickly added poses that were way above a beginner level. Not happy at all. I would say stick with yoga instruction you can find on YouTube or your smart tv. Ugh. $ down the drain for sure.
Wonderful. Very easy to follow and the program lets me stay on track
Disappointed. Disappointed that it’s so basic little pictures without any direction except another little basic bland very tiny picture in the corner of screen! I wasted $30

What the ????. Download. 
Answer a few questions. 
THEN $$$!!!!
Seriously- no free demo or trial period.
How do I cancel?. This app does not work for me. I would like to cancel. I am not able to click on links on app. Thank you.
Want to cancel, no option. I want to cancel and get a refund. Cannot find. Links not working in app. Please advise.

Yoga for weight loss. This program is very disappointing. It has several glitches. Often times the picture of the pose does not match the verbal instructions of the pose. The poses do not flow together. I would like my money back.

Terrible. Bought the app as it looks like a gentle, structured way to get into yoga. There are guided workouts that are a little different as the days progress. The problem is the app will get stuck on day 1 for three days, and it’s the second day that it’s been stuck on day 2. There’s no contact information through the app itself although I did reach out to the developer on the App Store and have not yet received a reply. Looking for a refund!

Not as described, typos, no transitions. If you’re looking for a quick fix, this might fit your needs, but there is no flow to these poses. One jumps to the next. There are A LOT of corpse and mountain poses, which are nothing other than lying flat and standing up. Not exactly the calorie burning weight loss program that was described.

NOT FOR BEGINNERS. No modified poses offered and the voice over doesn’t not match the actual pose on the screen some poses are held too long leading to potential injury, which is what happened to me. DO NOT RECOMMEND
I cannot delete app and I need room on phone. I feel as though I have been duped.. I have not tried, but looks like it is worth the money. ONLY IF YOU HAVE IT!!!!

Poses are fair, program is horrible. I’d give it negative stars if I could.
I am a healthy woman, having practiced yoga for many years. I tried this app, hoping for minimal guidance in a daily comfortable routine. These routines are incredibly poorly organized, moving from standing to sitting to lying down with apparently no thought given to the necessary transition between poses. I experienced incapacitating vertigo after practicing with this app (due to the lack of appropriate transitioning), and will never use it again. I emailed customer service, and received no response. This is not yoga, and I cannot believe they’re calling it yoga. Save your money, try a different app.

Program getting stuck. Hi the problem I’m having is that the program gets stuck when transitioning to the next day. It won’t let me advance. I’m doing the “ 7 minute yoga program” and it won’t let me move pass day 5. I’m really enjoying it and was hoping to gradually get into move difficult programs but this has left me very frustrated.

Ridiculous!. A computer-generated voice and cartoons. If you’re an expert who can sit cross-legged, cross your arms in front of you, reach around behind yourself and hold both of your feet then you might like this. Its as though the computer dreamed up the poses. This app is laughably bad. I’m getting a refund.
Have to subscribe to even try. Not clear before downloading that this is a pay to use app. Takes all your data and then you have to subscribe to do/see anything.

Total rip-off. Don’t do it. You can’t preview the app without paying $19.99. So you do, because it gets good reviews. And then you find out that it’s very very basic graphics, very very basic narration and you can’t get your money back.
Just beginning. I have trouble getting up and down as fast as the teacher goes. I’ll get better eventually

Please help!. I would like to unsubscribe. I spent $20 because you don’t get to do anything unless you subscribe. I do not like this app. It is not what I expected at all. I would like to unsubscribe so that I do not receive recurring charges but I don’t know how. Please direct me. Thank you.

Not what I hoped for. I’ve been using this app daily for more than 30 days. The complexes “selected” for me based on my goals are labeled beginner but there are several poses that are intermediate or advanced mixed in. Some of the advanced poses are described way too quickly and the picture does not help to show what the pose should be. Some of the pose descriptions do not match the name or the picture at all. The sequence of the asanas seems haphazard (going from lying on the floor to standing to sitting to standing, back to the floor, back to standing). I have not lost any weight but my flexibility is increasing (the poses are good for stretching muscles that are chair bound for most of the day). I read the reviews before I purchased and one mentioned “the great recipes included” - there are no recipes in this app. It’s now obvious most of all the 5 star reviews are fake. I regret what I paid for this app.

Cost is $60 per year. Or less for shorter periods of time. This is not disclosed from what I can see until you download the App.

This pricing information should be Fully disclosed Before you download the app and enter your personal information
No customer service. I have been trying to cancel this membership for over a month and you will not allow me to do so. Do not continue to charge me!
Yoga. I have just begun using this app so I don’t have a lot of info to share right now
Cancel. Am I locked into this yoga app? How do I cancel?

Horrible. Horrible program. It consists of cartoon drawings showing and holding poses for 30 seconds pose after pose. No flow, no instruction on getting from one position to the other. After trying 5 different “programs” I quit. Do not recommend at all and after 15 min wasted and $30 I’m requesting a refund.
Crash. Just downloaded app. 3 x crash won’t open. Shut down iPhone 12 Pro Max and relaunched app. Cars 2 x. Will delete until bugs squashed
Ugh.. Downloaded 5 min ago and I’m already stuck and can’t move forward in the settings.
Don’t waste your $$. Not seeing any “weight loss” exercises as previewed in ad for app. Signed up for $9.99 version for 1 month to see if I liked the app and account was charger $19.99!
Horrible. Downloaded the app and it won’t even open. What app, all you get is an icon.
No trial. The app requires me to sign up just to see how it works. No trial period. If I click on the bottom menu buttons nothing happens and the app locks up if I don’t but the membership.
Can’t use unless you pay $20 month. So much for free yoga
Height....not Hight......🤦‍♀️. At least spell check.

Good for those with time constraints but very little transition time between poses. I am not new to yoga but have been doing it for decades. I have a busy work day and take some time during my lunch break to do a bit of yoga and relax. These exercises are great but each pose moves into the next without much time to transition and given some poses are held for 10 or less seconds there is next to no time to hold some poses as well as one has to move fast from lying flat to standing up or kneeling and such. Pausing the app to transition to next pose would defeat the whole purpose of these exercises to be calming and relaxing and involving smooth transitions. It would also help if the program reminds one to breathe (inhale/exhale) throughout poses as that is a key component to yoga.

Worst app ever. I read the reviews and therefor purchased the app. Quite expensive but I thought i would try it. This morning I did the first workout and stopped midway. it is the worst yoga practice i have ever done. All animated, no breathing guidance, actually no guidance whatsoever. There is no flow as there usually is with yoga. There are many apps out there and this is the most unprofessional i have ever experienced. I would like a refund.

So bad!. The instructions do not always match up with the poses.
The poses do not flow well at all.
The voice is annoying.

False Advertising. You download the app for free, fill out a bunch of questions, and then they expect you to pay $60 a year to get your yoga routine. Nothing about this in the description though. Deleted the app.

Hate this app. Beware. I downloaded app but decided not to continue. I was offered discount to $29 / yr when I started to close. After accepting $29/yr rate, the app got stuck on $59/ yr. I don’t trust the app and want to cancel but can’t find an option to do that. I don’t want to get stuck paying this every year. Don’t know if they are billing me $29 or $59 and don’t trust the app. I want to get out of this

Why did I just pay for this app and still need more $$$?. I wanted to try this but before I could get my personalized plan they asked for more money. 
Please refund and delete me from this. 

Seems like false advertising to me.

Great for beginners. I hadn’t done yoga in many years and never felt comfortable in a group class. This app is great. I’m slowly getting back on track. It provides a go-at-your-own-pace progression, easy to follow and very rewarding. I’ve lost a few inches, a few lbs, and I feel fantastic!

Hard to cancel subscription. Terms and agreements they to cancel go to subscriptions. They don’t tell you how to get to subscriptions to cancel. I tried to cancel this the same day that I ordered it and it was a problem because I could not do it.

Ridiculously charged when told I wouldn’t be. I clicked on the $1.07/month option and it immediately charged me $65.45 right off the bat. I need an immediate refund of my money since I did not agree to this charge. This is ridiculous.
